profile.headline: Software Developer at Amsurg
profile.summary:
I'm currently working for a healthcare company developing their proprietary software using React, Nextjs, Remix, SQL and C#/.net, Microsoft Azure DevOps, and CI/CD concepts in a collaborative, agile environment.

https://github.com/brownabs
https://abbeybrown.netlify.app

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
•Application development and troubleshooting for the company's proprietary software using Javascript, CSS, TypeScript, React, C#, .NET/Core, Azure DevOps and SQL.
•Design, documentation, development, debugging, and testing of software to provide new system functionality following team coding standards and processes.
•Cross-collaboration with departments and peer programming for time-critical development, troubleshooting and migrations following agile methodology.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Assisting with the teaching of adult learners for NSS's front end development course. 
• Working in a development team environment and assisting with cultivating student lessons
• Mentoring projects and analyzing student's code for trouble shooting errors in applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, React and Firebase.

positions.title: Food Server/Host
positions.description:
• Customer Service -- provided exceptional service to customers
• Training -- trained new hires 
• Multitasking -- attending multiple customers at a time

positions.title: B2B / EDI Analyst
positions.description:
• Ensuring vendor satisfaction and success in B2B EDI relations
• On boarding vendors and leading them through TSC EDI procedures
• Analyzing EDI documents to ensure tests pass TSC standards
• Troubleshooting errors to solve EDI transfer issues
• Data entry and ticket support using SAP, Jira, and ServicePortal platforms
• Working with different departments to ensure timely and cohesive vendor on boarding

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Full Stack Web Development six month bootcamp teaching  C#/.net, React.js, Javascript
through individual and team-based projects.

• Using React, HTML, CSS built browser-based single page applications
• Object Oriented Programming fundamentals
• Version control with Git/GitHub
• Task Automation with Grunt: Linting with ESLint, module bundling with Browserify

positions.title: Shipping Manager & Administrative Support Specialist
positions.description:
Shipping Manager:  
• Handling receiving inventory, distribution, packaging and shipping operations.
• Self-Direction -- was the first employee to become IATA certified so that they company could legally 
   ship batteries. 
• Leadership -- taught fellow coworkers the guidelines of shipping batteries

Administrative Support Specialist:  
• Multitasking and Customer Service -- first line of contact for customers; handled multiple phone lines, 
   transferred to appropriate personnel and handle complaints
• Accounting -- recorded and managed accounts receivable and payable

projects.title: Brewster
projects.description:
Front-End Capstone project for Nashville Software School. 
An app for home brewers that allows the user to keep track of beer recipes and stages of fermentation. Created this project using React, Moment.js and CSS. I was able to combine my love for home brewing with my newly learned React skills. Brewster is deployed using AWS S3.

projects.title: React Nutshell
projects.description: Group project building an application that allows the user to implement CRUD with tasks, news articles, messages and friends. Created using React. I was able to work on the tasks portion of the project.
